name: veterinary_clinic_system_060_geriatric_panel_recall
instruction: Geriatric screening recall: dogs and cats aged 7 years or older (as of the episode date, computed from dob) who have NOT had a 'CBC' or 'Serum chemistry panel' lab result in the last 365 days are due for senior bloodwork (standard senior-wellness practice — verify if unsure). For each due patient push one reminder_queue row {kind: 'senior_lab_recall', patient_id, owner_id: <patient's owner>, message: '<PatientName> (age <age in whole years>) is due for senior bloodwork — CBC + chemistry.', status: 'queued', queued_by: 'system', queued_at: episode timestamp, due_date: episode date}. Then push ONE communications summary row to owner of the clinic (owner_id '1'): {channel: 'email', direction: 'outbound', subject: 'Senior recall batch <batch_code>', body: '<N> senior patients recalled for bloodwork.', logged_by: 'system', occurred_at: episode timestamp}. Seeded rows untouched.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute: canine/feline patients with (ep - dob).days >= 7*365 (age in whole years via date arithmetic); exclude those with a lab_results row test_name in ('CBC','Serum chemistry panel') and resulted within 365d of ep. Assert exact per-patient rows (message age must match whole-year age at ep) + one summary row with N == created count; totals exact; seeded untouched.

checks.expect: Recompute: canine/feline patients with (ep - dob).days >= 7*365 (age in whole years via date arithmetic); exclude those with a lab_results row test_name in ('CBC','Serum chemistry panel') and resulted

domain_searches.query: AAHA canine vaccination guidelines rabies DHPP bordetella booster interval adult dog
top_results: 2022 AAHA Core and Noncore Vaccines for Dogs (Table 2)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Age derivation from dob + negative-evidence join (no recent lab) + summary-count consistency; three ways to be subtly wrong.
